name: fub-mcp
description: Work with your Follow Up Boss CRM from Claude: look up contacts and notes, log calls, create tasks, manage deals, and more.
long_description: An unofficial Follow Up Boss connector. Starts in View information mode. Turn on View and update records in extension settings to enable ordinary changes. Deletes, webhook administration and direct workflow triggers require separate advanced opt-ins. Uses your own FUB API key; results are shared with your chosen assistant.

api_key.title: Follow Up Boss API Key
api_key.description: Your personal API key. In Follow Up Boss, go to Admin > API and copy it. It is stored in your computer's secure keychain and is never sent anywhere except directly to Follow Up Boss.

system_name.title: (Optional) Your registered system ID
system_name.description: Leave blank unless you registered your own system with Follow Up Boss (recommended for heavy use; see the README). This is the 'System ID Header' you chose when registering.

system_key.title: (Optional) Your system key
system_key.description: Leave blank unless you registered your own system. This is a secret: paste it only here, never into a chat or email. Stored in your system keychain.

allow_write.title: View and update records
allow_write.description: Off: View information only. On: also create and update records. Restart the extension after changing. Deletes, webhooks and direct workflow triggers stay off.

allow_delete.title: Advanced: allow permanent deletes
allow_delete.description: Requires View and update records. Each delete also requires confirmation.

allow_webhooks.title: Advanced: manage webhooks
allow_webhooks.description: Requires View and update records. New/changed destinations must match Allowed webhook hosts.

allow_automations.title: Advanced: trigger workflows directly
allow_automations.description: Requires View and update records. Allows lead events, Action Plans and Automation triggers; these can cause communications.

webhook_hosts.title: Advanced: allowed webhook hosts
webhook_hosts.description: Exact HTTPS hostnames, comma-separated (no URLs or wildcards). Required when creating/changing webhook destinations.
